blocks.text: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist is a fashion aesthetic and TikTok microtrend that emerged in 2023, which consists of outfits inspired by the female protagonists in popular Japanese horror games, most notably the Fatal Frame series. The aesthetic is related to and largely reliant on Coquette fashion, specifically the Dark Nymphet subtype, with added 2000s-era Japanese influences. It is characterized by dark-colored, hyper-feminine pieces, layered with accessories to evoke the appearance of heroines from Japanese horror media.

As this aesthetic is based on Japanese horror media, specifically video games, the fashion intentionally tries to emulate the style portrayed within those games. The tops common to that niche type of media include babydoll, empire-waist, and Milkmaid tops, and tops with puff, flutter, and frill sleeves. They often have lace trims around the neck and hem, ruffles, ribbons, and scoop, square or sweetheart necklines. Peter Pan collars are typical, as are puritan and sailor collars. From the trend's Japanese roots, you will also see a lot of tops that have Kawaii details, especially from the brand Axes Femme. From its Y2K inspirations, it gets knit tops with contrasting collars, Henley shirts, feminine-cut blouses and fitted baby tees.

Layering is a key aspect of this style. Fitted lace shrugs and cardigans or fitted vests are often layered above babydoll dresses, blouses, and ruffle-hemmed tops. All of these tops are often worn untucked and pulled over the bottoms, elongating the waist, which was also a trend from the early 2000s.

For those those who prefer the aesthetics of Resident Evil or Silent Hill over the more typically feminine Fatal Frame looks, aspects of the outfit could lean more towards tactical fashion. In this variation, knit turtlenecks and puffer vests are popular and emulate the character Heather Mason from Silent Hill 3; though not strictly fitting into the aesthetic, this variation provides a more casual, and possibly even more tomboy-ish, alternative to this trend.

Japanese Horror Game Protagonist fashion contains multiple references to schoolgirl fashion, as the protagonists are often of that age. Specifically, pleated miniskirts, solid or plaid, are very popular and easy to find in comparison to many of the pieces from Japan. The short length also contributes to the hyper-feminine, sometimes sexy, look that is common in Coquette fashion.

Frilly, tiered ruffle skirts, often trimmed with lace or an interesting fabric, are also a common choice, typical to the hyper-feminine protagonists of certain games. A more practical alternative is denim skirts; longer, flowing maxi skirts can be used as well. Sometimes, dark, light or faded colored shorts, capris, and pants can be utilized -- especially bell-bottomed or yoga pants, or cigarette pants. Ruffled bloomer shorts are also a popular choice beneath babydoll tops or dresses.

Socks and tights are common here, often used to emphasize long legs and add a bit of coverage beneath short skirts. Knee- and thigh-high socks are typical to this trend, as are opaque stockings, leg warmers and boot socks.

Jewelry is important to this aesthetic, too -- chokers are a very popular choice, especially plain black ones or ones with a single dangling pendant, as are necklaces, also with pendants (typically Gothic crosses, hearts, or skeleton keys).
Bows and ribbons can be used to adorn all garments within this aesthetic, as well as in the hair, which can also be decorated with hair clips, head bands and barrettes.
For shoes, usually knee-high boots, Mary Janes, or loafer pumps are worn, though ballet flats, kitten heels, and combat or other ankle boots would also work.

Music associated with the Japanese Horror Game Protagonist aesthetic usually consists of the genres dream pop and ethereal wave, shoegaze, lo-fi, bedroom pop, and dark ambient, often incorporating songs (or samples) off of the soundtracks of the above listed video games.
